searchSummary.en: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Sol to ChatGPT Work and Codex users, accompanied by a system-card addendum that classifies it as Critical in cybersecurity and High in biological and chemical capability.
searchSummary.zhHans: OpenAI 面向 ChatGPT Work 与 Codex 用户发布 GPT-6.1 Sol，并发布系统卡补充文件，将其网络安全能力评为 Critical、生物与化学能力评为 High。

summary.en: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Sol to ChatGPT Work and Codex users, accompanied by a system-card addendum that classifies it as Critical in cybersecurity and High in biological and chemical capability.
summary.zhHans: OpenAI 面向 ChatGPT Work 与 Codex 用户发布 GPT-6.1 Sol，并发布系统卡补充文件，将其网络安全能力评为 Critical、生物与化学能力评为 High。

narrative.en: The release expands the GPT-6 product family with a lower-priced model and the same safeguards stack used for GPT-6 Astra. OpenAI’s capability and cost comparisons remain company claims, and no qualifying production adoption or independently replicated workflow change was established by the cutoff.
narrative.zhHans: 该发布为 GPT-6 产品系列增加了价格较低的新模型，并采用与 GPT-6 Astra 相同的安全防护栈。OpenAI 对能力与成本的比较仍属于公司主张，截至截止日尚未证明符合门槛的生产采用或经独立复现的工作流变化。

text.en: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Sol on September 29, 2026.
text.zhHans: OpenAI 于 2026 年 9 月 29 日发布 GPT-6.1 Sol。

text.en: Performance and cost comparisons with GPT-6 Astra are vendor-reported and were not independently replicated by the cutoff.
text.zhHans: 与 GPT-6 Astra 的性能和成本比较来自厂商披露，截至截止日未得到独立复现。
